scope: Local development server and production preview only; no public host or third-party service tested

findings.title: Malformed local contribution ID crashes Contribute dialog
findings.prerequisite: Ability to modify this origin's localStorage
findings.reproduction: Store a landmark contribution with id equal to an object containing toString:null, then open Contribute
findings.fix: Accept only string or finite numeric contribution IDs before rendering
findings.verified: Crash reproduced before patch and rejected after patch in development and production preview

findings.title: Local Vite servers do not send security response headers
findings.nextStep: Configure appropriate headers on the eventual HTTPS production host and verify there
findings.limitation: No deployed host was provided or assessed

limitations: Passing these payloads does not prove the application is free of vulnerabilities
Missing secret files returning the SPA HTML does not prove all possible file disclosure paths are blocked
No backend, database, authentication system, or public hosting configuration exists in the assessed app
SQL-like input was tested only for safe frontend handling; there is no database to test for SQL injection
External browser requests were blocked during browser tests; npm audit separately queried the npm registry
